verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists "custom summaries" as a product feature, which is first-party evidence that notes can be shaped beyond one generic format. Nothing shows templates or saved prompts assigned per meeting type: the meeting-type evidence covers only an API filter for listing meetings, which is a different capability. missing for 10: documentation of how custom summary templates or prompts are created, per-meeting-type assignment (discovery, 1:1, standup), saved or reusable prompt management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can shape the notes with custom templates or saved prompts per meeting type (discovery call, 1:1, standup) instead of one generic format

citations.quote: Advanced call summaries, including custom summaries
